global_guardrails: Do not request personal identifiers or sensitive individual-level health data.
Do not treat access permission as scientific gate passage; schema, provenance, bias, and validation gates must still pass.
Do not claim risk, Rt, abundance, spillover, host-switch, or causality from source discovery alone.
Keep credentials and private data outside Git and DVC metadata unless explicitly approved and properly protected.
purpose: Identify the minimum external data needed to move beyond public/self-service ResearchOps closeout toward higher-impact Hanta scientific discovery.
recommended_next_route: host_infection_trapping_prevalence if ecology discovery is the goal; human_incidence_hfrs_hps_panel if human risk/Rt is the goal; cross_pathogen_gate_framework_comparison if a methods paper is the goal

routes.access_mode: permission_or_manual_public_extraction; some public aggregate routes already captured but insufficient
candidate_sources: China CDC/NHC HFRS bulletins or notifiable disease tables
ECDC Surveillance Atlas source extract with terms/suppression review
national public health agencies by country
routes.claim_boundary: no human risk, Rt, or surveillance join until a harmonized outcome and protocol exist
routes.claim_if_acquired: descriptive human incidence or formal Rt/risk only after schema, terms, bias, and validation gates pass
routes.first_contact_or_action: prepare data request to public health agencies for de-identified aggregate monthly HFRS/HPS counts with metadata; continue manual verification of official public machine-readable tables
minimum_unblock_criteria: consistent case definition or documented harmonization
routes.scientific_question: Can harmonized human hantavirus incidence support formal risk or Rt analysis?
routes.target_outcome: confirmed/probable human HFRS/HPS case counts by geography and time

candidate_sources: national surveillance or academic rodent monitoring programs
routes.claim_boundary: no abundance surface or host infection suitability from occurrence-only or effort-free trapping files
routes.claim_if_acquired: host infection prevalence or abundance modeling only after effort harmonization and detection-bias gates pass
routes.current_project_status: host_abundance_blocked_no_effort_harmonized_cross_study_trapping_frame; USGS files screened only within-study availability
routes.first_contact_or_action: inventory target studies and request site-level de-identified trapping/testing tables with trap effort and assay metadata
routes.scientific_question: Can host infection prevalence or trapping effort support reservoir/environmental inference?
routes.target_outcome: rodent host infection/test positivity and/or capture counts with effort by site/time/species

candidate_sources: NCBI GenBank/Entrez sequence bodies already partly downloaded
routes.claim_boundary: alignment readiness is not host-switch inference; no spillover or reassortment claim without tree/model QC
routes.claim_if_acquired: phylogenetic design or host-state transition analysis only after audit and prespecified model gates pass
routes.first_contact_or_action: expand public sequence manifest into a taxonomy/provenance audit queue and request metadata clarification for ambiguous high-value accessions
minimum_unblock_criteria: sampling adequacy and contamination review documented
routes.scientific_question: Can curated Hantaan/Hantaviridae sequences support host-switch, reassortment, or lineage movement analysis?
routes.target_outcome: segment-specific curated alignments with audited host, geography, date, and provenance metadata

routes.claim_boundary: do not transfer Ebola transmission/Rt assumptions to Hanta biology
routes.claim_if_acquired: methodological claim about gate-based public-data ResearchOps and claim control
routes.current_project_status: ready_for_methods_synthesis_if Ebola artifacts are audited in the same framework
routes.first_contact_or_action: build a two-project gate matrix and identify which Ebola gates are truly comparable to Hanta gates
minimum_unblock_criteria: Ebola and Hanta gate definitions aligned
case-study differences framed as methods not biology
routes.scientific_question: Can Hanta versus Ebola workflows demonstrate a general formal-gate framework for public-data infectious-disease inference?
routes.target_outcome: cross-project gate matrix and reproducibility comparison, not biological disease outcome
